verdict.rationale: The product's own docs describe an AI agent driving a real iPhone through an ESP32 acting as mouse and AirPlay receiver. The user types a plain-language goal, and the agent taps, swipes and types (for example, setting an alarm in Clock); runs replay with the taps and swipes drawn on top. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that tasks complete reliably, beyond the project's own README.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent operates a real phone (tap, swipe, type) to finish a task I describe in plain language

citations.quote: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32.
Type a goal (for example "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi") and press Start.
the agent leaves its own app, opens Clock, types the time into the wheel, ticks the days and saves.
replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top.
The board is now the AirPlay receiver and the mouse, and the agent runs in an iPhone app on the same phone.
